Maintain 6-8.5 kg/m3 of excess Gypsum in the system at all times, but preferably lower concentration than higher. Tight hole and/or washing and reaming on trips through new hole drilled are often feature of clay and shale drilling that may not be alleviated or solved by increasing mud weight or changing

the BHA so as to minimize the possibility of large volumes of cuttings settling during connections, causing stuck pipe and packing off. Prior to trips the hole should be circulated for at least bottoms up, this will often prevent tight hole on the way out and bridges, fill etc. on the way back in. Cuttings at the shale shakers should be monitored for signs of cavings that may indicate need for increased mud weight. T
